quote: Centaurus Metals has received a non-binding Letter of Intent from the Brazilian Development Bank (BNDES) for R$1 billion (approximately US$190 million) of long-term project finance debt funding under the FINEM credit line for the Company’s 100%-owned Jaguar Nickel Sulphide Project in Brazil.
note: Opened Centaurus company primary; R$1bn / ~US$190m BNDES FINEM LOI confirmed. CapEx-fill uses company USD.
